sources.title: Artificial Analysis Music Generation Leaderboard — Instrumental
sources.scope: Blind pairwise human-preference ranking of generated instrumental audio.
limitations: Elo is task- and cohort-specific.
Does not measure score edit correctness, collaboration, causal reciprocity, user agency, rights, or event-level control.

sources.title: Artificial Analysis Music Generation Leaderboard — Vocals
sources.scope: Blind pairwise human-preference ranking of generated vocal music.
limitations: Separate board and task from instrumental ranking.
Does not measure score edit correctness, collaboration, causal reciprocity, user agency, or rights.

sources.title: MIREX 2026 Symbolic Music Generation Results
sources.scope: Human ratings of symbolic music generation/continuation on coherence, structure, creativity and musicality.
limitations: Small reported panel: 8 prompts, 12 participants and 38 ratings per model.
Selected samples from eight candidates; do not compare to audio Elo.
Does not measure reciprocal interaction or exact-edit preservation.

sources.title: SMEBench: Benchmarking Instruction Following for Music Editing
sources.scope: Paired source/target music edits across 12 edit operations, with synthetic/constructed and real-audio cohorts.
limitations: Dataset scope is not a single scalar model ranking.
Target agreement, source preservation and text compatibility must remain separate.

sources.title: Suno Studio 2.0 — official help documentation
sources.scope: Documented generative music production workflow and editing capabilities.
limitations: Product documentation is capability evidence, not independent benchmark performance.
Capabilities can change; verify availability and regional/account conditions when testing.

sources.title: Google Lyria RealTime API documentation
sources.scope: Persistent streaming audio generation with live prompt and configuration steering.
sources.version_snapshot: Lyria RealTime experimental API as documented 2026-11-21
limitations: Streaming audio controls are not equivalent to symbolic note/event editing.
Do not score note-level control where the API does not expose note-level events.
Configuration transitions and reset semantics must be included in timing/continuity tests.

sources.title: YuE2: Agentic Score Planning and Editing for Music Generation
sources.scope: Score-first full-song planning and realization, with conversational score/arrangement editing described in the research release.
limitations: Research capability description is not a matched independent preference result.
Score-first planning is not itself proof of persistent event identity, reversible edits, causal collaboration or preservation guarantees.

sources.title: MAGE: Modality-Agnostic Music Generation and Mixture-Grounded Editing
sources.scope: Multimodal conditional music generation and mixture-grounded target-source editing.
limitations: Generation/source-extraction comparison, not general symbolic score-edit correctness.
Do not infer arbitrary score-level event identity or protected-region guarantees from mixture-grounded source extraction.

sources.title: JAM_BOT: Expressive Human–AI Musical Improvisation
sources.scope: Real-time symbolic and expressive human–AI improvisation, with variable-tempo call-and-response and MIDI timing work.
limitations: Closest live symbolic-interaction comparator, but not a matched result against Muse yet.
Performance depends on instrument, clock, MIDI interface, buffering and latency compensation.

comparison_rules: Only compare scores within the same benchmark, version, split, modality, task definition and metric implementation.
Never compare instrumental Elo, vocal Elo, symbolic 0–5 ratings, editing accuracy or reciprocal-interaction effects as if they shared a scale.
Reproduce the external baseline on its official split before tuning or claiming improvement.
Pin exact model/API version, date, prompt set, decoding, retries, compute budget, renderer and scorer digest for every new result.
Retain every attempt, parse failure, timeout, abstention and invalid output in the denominator or report it explicitly.
A product feature list is not benchmark performance; a benchmark score is not proof of agency, authorship, rights or collaboration.
Use matched capability surfaces. For audio-only APIs, do not fabricate note-level or score-level controls.
Publish quality, exact editing, preservation, latency, recovery, agency, rights/provenance and cost as separate dimensions; do not collapse them into a composite score.
All numerical targets for Muse are prospective qualification objectives until a pinned, exact-head result and independent evaluation evidence exist.
